ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels across the primary surface area with localized high-intensity (white) clusters; macro-ratio estimated at approximately 1:12.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark-gray to black pigmentation across the visible ventral field. High-contrast white circular blobs are distributed as isolated units across the medial regions, with dense geometric clusters mapped to the distal lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression with a wide vertex angle; bounding-box depth is relatively shallow compared to the total width of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire continuous linear boundary. Pixel-amplitude of peaks is non-uniform, showing significant jagged offsets particularly on the distal halves of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: S-shaped trajectory comprising a proximal convex curve transitioning to a distal concavity as the lobes taper toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular white ring clusters (approx. 5-8 pixels in diameter) scattered across both lobes; dense constellation at the far-left terminal tip and a dispersed pattern across the mid-right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, short, parallel linear pixel disruptions (white rake marks) visible on the mid-left lobe, oriented diagonally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and deep serrations on the trailing edge. A large, circular, low-contrast depressed area is visible on the lower-medial section of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced three-dimensional calcified protrusions (barnacle colonization) localized on the outer distal edges of both the left and right lobes.
